sentences.text: Valencia -LRB- -LSB- vəˈlɛnsiə -RSB- -LSB- baˈlenθja -RSB- -RRB- , officially València -LRB- -LSB- vaˈlensia -RSB- -RRB- , is the capital of the autonomous community of Valencia and the third largest city in Spain after Madrid and Barcelona , with around 800,000 inhabitants in the administrative centre .	Valencia	Valencian Community	autonomous community	autonomous communities of Spain	third largest city	municipalities of Spain	Madrid	Madrid	Barcelona	Barcelona	Spain	Spain
Its urban area extends beyond the administrative city limits with a population of around 1.5 -- 1.6 million people .

Valencia is Spain 's third largest metropolitan area , with a population ranging from 1.7 to 2.5 million .	Valencia	Valencian Community	third largest metropolitan area	List of metropolitan areas in Spain	Spain	Spain

The Port of Valencia is the 5th busiest container port in Europe and the busiest container port on the Mediterranean Sea .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Port of Valencia	Port of Valencia	5th busiest container port in Europe	List of busiest ports in Europe	Mediterranean Sea	Mediterranean Sea
The city is ranked at Gamma in the Globalization and World Cities Research Network .	Globalization and World Cities Research Network	Globalization and World Cities Research Network

Valencia was founded as a Roman colony by the consul Decimus Junius Brutus Callaicus in 138 BC , and called Valentia Edetanorum .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Roman	Roman Republic	Decimus Junius Brutus Callaicus	Decimus Junius Brutus Callaicus

In 714 Moroccan and Arab Moors occupied the city , introducing their language , religion and customs ; they implemented improved irrigation systems and the cultivation of new crops as well , being capital of the Taifa of Valencia .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Moors	Moors	Taifa of Valencia	Taifa of Valencia

In 1238 the Christian king James I of Aragon reconquered the city and divided the land among the nobles who helped him conquer it , as witnessed in the Llibre del Repartiment .	James I of Aragon	James I of Aragon	Llibre del Repartiment	Llibre del Repartiment (Valencia)

He also created a new law for the city , the Furs of Valencia , which were extended to the rest of the Kingdom of Valencia .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Furs of Valencia	Furs of Valencia	Kingdom of Valencia	Kingdom of Valencia

In the 18th century Philip V of Spain abolished the privileges as punishment to the kingdom of Valencia for aligning with the Habsburg side in the War of the Spanish Succession .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Philip V of Spain	Philip V of Spain	Habsburg side	Habsburg Spain	War of the Spanish Succession	War of the Spanish Succession	Spain	Spain
Valencia was the capital of Spain when Joseph Bonaparte moved the Court there in the summer of 1812 .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Spain	Spain	Joseph Bonaparte	Joseph Bonaparte
It also served as capital between 1936 and 1937 , during the Second Spanish Republic .	Second Spanish Republic	Second Spanish Republic

The city is situated on the banks of the Turia , on the east coast of the Iberian Peninsula , fronting the Gulf of Valencia on the Mediterranean Sea .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Mediterranean Sea	Mediterranean Sea	Turia	Turia (river)	Iberian Peninsula	Iberian Peninsula	Gulf of Valencia	Gulf of Valencia

Its historic centre is one of the largest in Spain , with approximately 169 hectares ; this heritage of ancient monuments , views and cultural attractions makes Valencia one of the country 's most popular tourist destinations .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Spain	Spain
Valencia is integrated into an industrial area on the Costa del Azahar -LRB- Orange Blossom Coast -RRB- .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Costa del Azahar	Costa del Azahar
Valencia 's main festival is the Falles .	Valencia	Valencian Community	Falles	Falles
The traditional Spanish dish , paella , originated in Valencia .	Valencia	Valencian Community	paella	paella
